title: Sharepoint Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Power Apps \& SQL , Altreyx**
**Position Details**
 EY’s GDS Assurance Digital team’s mission is to develop, implement and integrate technology solutions that better serve our audit clients and engagement teams. As a member of EY’s core Assurance practice, you’ll develop a deep Audit related technical knowledge and outstanding database, data analytics and programming skills.
   

  

 Ever\-increasing regulations require audit departments to gather, organize and analyses more data than ever before. Often the data necessary to satisfy these ever\-increasing and complex regulations must be collected from a variety of systems and departments throughout an organization. Effectively and efficiently handling the variety and volume of data is often extremely challenging and time consuming for a company.
   

  

 EY's GDS Assurance Digital team members work side\-by\-side with the firm's partners, clients and audit technical subject matter experts to develop and incorporate technology solutions that enhance value\-add, improve efficiencies and enable our clients with disruptive and market leading tools supporting Assurance.
   

  

 GDS Assurance Digital provides solution architecture, application development, testing and maintenance support to the global Assurance service line both on a pro\-active basis and in response to specific requests.
   

  

**Requirements (including Experience, Skills And Additional Qualifications)**
* A bachelor’s degree (BE/BTech/MCA \& MBA) in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems Management, Accounting, Finance or a related field with adequate industry experience.


**Technical Skills Requirements**
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in SharePoint development, including experience with SharePoint Online and SPFx.
* Strong experience with Power Apps, Power Automate, and the broader Power Platform.
* Proficiency in web development technologies, including React, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
* Design and develop robust, scalable Power Apps and SharePoint Online solutions using the SharePoint Framework (SPFx) and other modern development practices.
* Lead the technical design sessions, architecting solutions that fulfill business requirements while aligning with EY's technology standards and best practices.
* Develop custom web parts, extensions, and applications using SPFx, React, TypeScript, and other modern web technologies.
* Implement complex workflows and business processes using Power Automate and integrate them with Power Apps and SharePoint Online.
* Ensure seamless integration of Power Apps and SharePoint solutions with other Microsoft 365 services and third\-party systems.
* Conduct code reviews, enforce coding standards, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
* Provide expert guidance and support to project teams, stakeholders, and end\-users, including documentation, training, and troubleshooting.
* Stay abreast of the latest developments in Microsoft 365, Power Platform, and SharePoint technologies to drive innovation and thought leadership within EY.
* Experience with Azure services, REST APIs, and external data sources integration.
* Excellent problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile methodologies.


**Good To Have Skills**
* Microsoft certifications in Power Platform and/or SharePoint.
* Experience with Microsoft Graph API.
* Knowledge of SharePoint PnP (Patterns and Practices).
* Prior consulting experience or experience working in a professional services firm.


**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**
* An ability to quickly understand complex concepts and use technology to support data modeling, analysis, visualization or process automation
* Selects appropriately from applicable standards, methods, tools and applications and uses accordingly
* Ability to work within a multi\-disciplinary team structure, but also independently
* Demonstrates analytical and systematic approach to problem solving
* Communicates fluently orally and in writing and can present complex technical information to both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Able to plan, schedule and monitor work activities in order to meet time and quality targets
* Able to absorb rapidly new technical information, business acumen, and apply it effectively
* Ability to work in a team environment with strong customer focus, good listening, negotiation and problem\-resolution skills


**Additional skills requirements:**
* The expectations are that a Senior will be able to maintain long\-term client relationships and network and cultivate business development opportunities
* Provide high quality client services by directing daily progress of engagement work, informing engagement manager of engagement status, and managing staff performance.
* Must have presentation skills ' ability to create PowerPoint deck to communicate solution architecture to various stakeholders.
* Should have understanding and experience of software development best practices
* Excellent business communication, Consulting, Quality process skills
* Must be a team player


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Motion Graphics & Product CGI Designer
description:
**Job Description** 




**Motion Graphics \& Product CGI Designer** 




**Department:** 
 Marketing \- Creative \& Design
 



**Location:** 
 Baidyanath Head Office, Kolkata
 



**Experience:** 
 6\-8 years
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**About the Role** 




 Baidyanath is looking for an experienced and creatively driven
 **Motion Graphics \& Product CGI Designer** 
 to develop premium, engaging and commercially effective visual content for Baidyanath and Goodcare.
 



 The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in
 **motion graphics, video editing, product animation and 3D/CGI visualisation** 
 , with a proven ability to transform marketing briefs into high\-quality, publish\-ready creative assets.
 



 This role requires someone who can independently conceptualise and execute product\-led reels, digital advertisements, educational videos, CGI product films and e\-commerce content. The candidate should combine technical expertise with strong visual aesthetics, storytelling and an understanding of marketing objectives.
 



 We are looking for an experienced professional who can take complete ownership of creative execution, maintain a premium visual standard and deliver projects with minimal supervision.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Motion Graphics \& Product Video Creation** 



* Conceptualise and create premium product\-led reels, animated advertisements, product launch videos and promotional content.
* Develop engaging motion graphics, kinetic typography, product reveals and ingredient animations.
* Translate product features and approved USPs into visually compelling stories.
* Create educational explainers, product\-benefit videos, demonstrations and brand\-led content.
* Develop attention\-grabbing opening hooks, engaging transitions, clear messaging and effective calls to action.
* Independently manage projects from storyboard and concept development through to final delivery.



**2\. Video Editing \& Post\-Production** 



* Edit doctor\-led videos, nutritionist explainers, influencer content, user\-generated content (UGC), testimonials and product demonstrations.
* Transform raw footage into high\-quality short\-form content through effective storytelling, pacing, transitions, captions and sound design.
* Perform compositing, colour correction, masking, retouching, clean\-up and final finishing.
* Integrate motion graphics, product renders and CGI elements into live\-action footage.
* Ensure all videos are polished, on\-brand and ready for publication.



**3\. Product CGI \& 3D Visualisation** 



* Create realistic 3D product renders and animations for bottles, jars, cartons, tubes, capsules and other FMCG and wellness products.
* Develop premium hero shots, product rotations, close\-ups, ingredient interactions and cinematic product reveals.
* Create realistic materials, lighting, shadows, reflections, textures and visual compositions.
* Accurately reproduce product shapes, packaging, labels, colours and proportions using approved artwork and references.
* Develop CGI concepts that enhance product storytelling and go beyond conventional product photography.
* Build reusable 3D assets for campaigns, digital advertising and e\-commerce content.



**4\. Performance Marketing \& Social Media Creatives** 



* Create high\-impact video advertisements for Meta, Instagram, YouTube and other digital platforms.
* Develop creative concepts that capture attention within the first three seconds.
* Produce multiple creative variations using different hooks, messaging, product presentations and CTAs for testing.
* Adapt master creatives into different durations, aspect ratios and platform\-specific formats.
* Collaborate with the performance marketing team to refine creative assets based on campaign feedback and performance insights.



**5\. E\-commerce, Marketplace \& D2C Content** 



* Develop product videos, ingredient animations, benefit explainers and demonstration videos for Amazon, Flipkart and other marketplaces.
* Create video assets for D2C product detail pages (PDPs), product listings and brand stores.
* Produce platform\-specific creatives for quick\-commerce channels such as Blinkit, Zepto and Swiggy Instamart.
* Ensure product communication is clear, visually appealing and aligned with marketplace specifications.
* Develop adaptations across SKUs, pack sizes and product variants while maintaining consistency.



**6\. Static Creative \& Product Design Support** 



* Convert CGI renders and video assets into premium static product creatives.
* Support the design team with product compositions, ingredient visuals, e\-commerce listing images, infographics and campaign adaptations.
* Maintain consistency in typography, colour, visual hierarchy, packaging accuracy and brand identity.



*Static design will be a supporting responsibility. The primary focus of this role will remain motion graphics, video production and product CGI.* 




**7\. Creative Ownership \& Collaboration** 



* Translate marketing briefs into original concepts, visual treatments, mood boards and storyboards.
* Explore creative ways to communicate Ayurveda, wellness, ingredients and product stories through a modern, premium visual language.
* Collaborate with marketing, content, design, e\-commerce and performance marketing teams.
* Take ownership of creative quality, timelines, revisions and final delivery.
* Maintain organised project files, editable working files and reusable creative assets.
* Ensure product packaging and on\-screen benefit claims match approved brand and product information.



**Required Technical Skills** 




**Essential** 



* **Adobe After Effects:** 
 Advanced motion graphics, animation, compositing and visual effects.
* **Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve:** 
 Professional video editing and post\-production.
* **Adobe Photoshop:** 
 Advanced image editing, manipulation and compositing.
* **Blender or Cinema 4D:** 
 Strong working knowledge of 3D product modelling, texturing, lighting, rendering and animation.



**Preferred** 



* Adobe Illustrator.
* Substance 3D Painter or Designer.
* Redshift, Octane, V\-Ray, Cycles or equivalent rendering engines.
* Houdini or other tools for advanced simulations.
* AI\-assisted creative tools and workflows.



*Candidates are not required to master every software listed. The ability to independently deliver high\-quality creative work is more important than proficiency in a large number of tools.* 




**Candidate Profile** 



* **6\-8 years of relevant professional experience** 
 in motion graphics, video production, product visualisation, CGI or related creative roles.
* Proven experience delivering complete product\-led videos and digital advertisements.
* Strong understanding of visual storytelling, composition, typography, colour and premium product aesthetics.
* Excellent knowledge of lighting, materials, reflections, shadows and realistic product presentation.
* Ability to balance creative innovation with brand consistency and marketing objectives.
* Strong understanding of social media, performance advertising and e\-commerce content requirements.
* Excellent attention to detail, particularly with packaging, labels, logos, product proportions and approved claims.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects and deliver within timelines.
* Strong creative problem\-solving skills and the ability to guide projects from concept to final output.



**Preferred Industry Experience** 




 Experience working with FMCG, beauty, skincare, wellness, nutraceutical, pharmaceutical, Ayurveda or other consumer product brands will be an advantage.
 



 Candidates from creative agencies, production studios or digital\-first consumer brands with strong product\-video portfolios are also welcome.
 



  





**Mandatory Portfolio Requirements** 




**A portfolio and video showreel must be submitted along with the CV.** 




 The portfolio should demonstrate:
 


1. At least two complete product\-led reels or digital advertisements.
2. High\-quality motion graphics and product animations.
3. At least one edited UGC, influencer, expert\-led or product\-demonstration video.
4. Photorealistic 3D product renders or CGI animations demonstrating lighting, materials and packaging accuracy.
5. E\-commerce product videos or product\-benefit explainers.
6. Original creative concepts demonstrating premium aesthetics and strong visual impact.

title: Shopify & CRO Specialist
description:
**Role at a Glance** 




**Team \- Website \& Conversions** 




**Location \- Hybrid \- Park Street Kolkata** 




  





**What this role actually does** 





 The Shopify \& CRO Specialist owns website performance for a portfolio of D2C brands. This role improves conversion rates through theme edits, landing page builds, A/B testing, and page speed work — sitting at the intersection of design, code, and data.
 




  





**About Studio APS** 





 Studio APS is a performance marketing agency based in Kolkata. We manage crores in annual ad spend across Meta, Google, and Amazon for fast\-growing D2C brands. We work in pod structures, go deep on fewer brands, and focus on measurable growth outcomes.
 




  





**Your week, roughly** 





 • Edit and build in Shopify — theme customisations, new sections, landing pages
 





 • Run CRO audits to identify where customers are dropping off in the funnel
 





 • Set up and analyse A/B tests on product pages, checkout, and landing pages
 





 • Optimise page speed and Core Web Vitals across assigned brand accounts
 





 • Improve product pages — layout, copy, trust signals, size guides, reviews
 





 • Build ad\-specific landing pages in collaboration with the media buying team
 





 • Support the SEO team with technical site fixes
 





 • Report on conversion metrics monthly and recommend next actions
 




  





**What we are looking for** 





 • 2\+ years working hands\-on in Shopify — you should be comfortable in the theme editor
 





 • Basic Liquid knowledge is a strong plus
 





 • You understand what makes a D2C product page convert, not just how it looks
 





 • Familiarity with Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, or similar heatmap tools
 





 • Detail\-oriented — you notice checkout friction before the client does
 





 • Agency experience managing multiple client accounts preferred
 




  





**Why Studio APS** 





 • Work across a diverse portfolio of fast\-growing D2C brands
 





 • Direct collaboration with media buyers — your work is tied directly to revenue
 





 • Small team, real ownership, no bureaucracy
 





 • Build skills across Shopify, CRO, and performance marketing in one role
 




  





**Where this role leads** 





 Strong CRO performers grow into Senior CRO or Head of Website roles. Cross\-functional growth into media buying or brand strategy is possible for the right person.
 




  





**How we work here** 





 Fully remove / On site both roles available. In\-office collaboration in Kolkata is welcomed and preferred for onboarding and team reviews.
 




  





**How to Apply:** 





 Fill out the form: https://forms.gle/6gf5XS4Sqf6uRSJz6
 




  





**Visit Our Careers Page** 





 https://studioaps.in/careers
 




  






 Alternatively Interested candidates should submit their resume, a cover letter detailing their experience and qualifications, and a portfolio or samples of previous work to info@studioaps.in. Please include "Shopify \& CRO Specialist" in the subject line. Linkedin Easy Apply is not preffered.

title: Junior Designer
description:
Junior Designer @ Shizz
 



**0–2 years \| Full\-time \| Kolkata** 




  





 We’re looking for someone who makes things look 👌
 



 Shizz is a digital agency working with brands across D2C, FMCG, beauty, food, lifestyle and everything in between.
 



 We’re looking for a 
 **Junior Designer** 
  who gets excited about good design, has an unhealthy amount of Pinterest/Instagram saved posts and can turn a random brief into something people actually want to look at.
 



  





**What you'll be doing** 



* Designing 
 **social media posts, carousels, stories \& ads** 
  that don't look like every other brand on Instagram.
* Turning creative ideas into scroll\-stopping visuals.
* Working on 
 **campaigns, launches, brand identities and digital content** 
 .
* Taking one design and making it work across 17 different formats because Instagram apparently needs that.
* Creating pitch decks and presentations that clients actually enjoy looking at.
* Working closely with our 
 **creative, strategy, copy and account teams** 
 .
* Bringing references, ideas, trends and "wait, hear me out..." concepts to the table.
* Taking feedback, making changes, questioning feedback occasionally, and making the work better.
* Keeping an eye on what's happening in 
 **design, advertising, culture and the internet** 
 .



  





**You should probably apply if...** 



* You have 
 **0–2 years of experience** 
  in graphic design, or you're a fresher with a killer portfolio.
* You know your way around 
 **Photoshop \& Illustrator** 
 .
* Bonus points if you know After Effects / Premiere Pro.
* You understand typography, composition, colour and visual hierarchy.
* You can make things look good 
 **without making them unnecessarily complicated** 
 .
* You have an eye for detail. Yes, that means noticing when things are 2 pixels off.
* You can handle multiple briefs without your laptop becoming a crime scene.
* You’re curious, proactive and actually want to get better at what you do.



  





**Extra points if...You:** 



* Know the difference between 
 **good design and design that just has a lot going on** 
 .
* Have strong opinions about fonts.
* Follow interesting brands instead of just design pages.
* Can explain 
 *why* 
  something works, not just that it "looks cool".
* Have a portfolio that makes us stop scrolling.
* Occasionally see an ad and think, 
 **"I could've made that better."**



  





**What Shizz is like** 




 You won't be sitting around making the same banner 47 times a day.
 



 You'll work across 
 **different brands, industries, briefs and creative challenges** 
 , and you'll get to see your work actually go out into the world.
 



 You'll work with strategists, copywriters, creatives and marketers. So you'll learn much more than just design.
 



  





**If you are a person who can get Shizz done, we would love to hear from you.**

title: UI UX Designer
description:
We are looking out for folks who are deeply passionate about working with tech Startups. If you live and breathe UX, this role is for you. As an
 **Senior UI UX Designer** 
 at Tech Exactly, you will get opportunities to work on great products (Mobile Apps \& Web Apps) from some of the smartest founders from around the world.
 



  





 𝐘𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐝𝐚𝐲 𝐭𝐨 𝐝𝐚𝐲 𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐩𝐨𝐧𝐬𝐢𝐛𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐞𝐬 𝐰𝐨𝐮𝐥𝐝 𝐛𝐞 𝐭𝐨 \-
 


* Interact with prospects and understand their business goals.
* Research \& Create user personas, user journey, and information architecture to lay foundation for top notch product experience.
* You would also have to present your research to the client.
* Create a low \& high fidelity wireframe during the pre\-sales and post\-sales phase to help clients understand the user journey.
* You would be required to guide the development team about the user journey.
* You will also be expected to design high quality user interfaces and get those approved from clients.
* You will also be expected to ensure the development team has all the design assets as and when they need it.
* You’d have to ensure the design handoff to the development team is smooth and there are no gaps in the handoff.
* You’ll have to closely review the development builds and provide feedback to ensure your UX/UI recommendations are adhered to.



  





 𝐑𝐞𝐪𝐮𝐢𝐫𝐞𝐝 𝐞𝐱𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐜𝐞, 𝐬𝐤𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐬𝐞𝐭𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐛𝐞𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐢𝐨𝐫𝐚𝐥 𝐜𝐡𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐜𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐢𝐜𝐬 \-
 


* Excellent English communication skills both written and spoken is a must for this role.
* Should have very strong analytical skills.
* Should be confident, organized, humble, patient, soft spoken, quick learner and most importantly driven to excel.
* Should have 4\+ experience doing UX/UI for Mobile App Development projects.
* Should understand Human interface guidelines.
* Should have basic knowledge on the app development process.
* Ability to come up with new concepts and help clients innovate is a big value add.
* Should have solid hands on experience with Figma.
* Should have design thinking.
* Knowledge in scrum will make your application stronger.
